records.title: Rotary Positional Embeddings as Phase Modulation: Theoretical Bounds on the RoPE Base for Long-Context Transformers
records.reason: The paper derives depth- and context-aware theoretical bounds for choosing RoPE base values in long-context LLMs and checks predictions across model families. It informs context-extension design but does not report a direct inference compute/latency reduction.

records.title: Spiral RoPE: Rotate Your Rotary Positional Embeddings in the 2D Plane
records.reason: Spiral RoPE adapts rotary positional encoding for 2D image-generation/vision-transformer representations; its experiments are visual generation, not long-context LLM inference.

records.title: Security and privacy in LLMs: A comprehensive survey of threats and mitigation strategies
records.reason: Publisher title identifies a security/privacy survey of LLMs; it is not an inference-efficiency paper and no concrete inference optimization is indicated.

records.title: iFSQ: Improving FSQ for Image Generation with 1 Line of Code
records.reason: iFSQ modifies finite scalar quantization for image-generation models. The change has no additional inference latency in that visual-model setting, but does not address LLM weights/KV or serving.

records.title: Synthetic Singers: A Review of Deep-Learning-based Singing Voice Synthesis Approaches
records.reason: This survey reviews deep-learning singing-voice-synthesis approaches. It is outside LLM inference/serving.
